notes.title: Update Summary – v1.0.2
notes.content: This update includes several interface and gameplay improvements, such as marking interrogation paths you’ve already tried, highlighting paths as new information becomes available, adding a case summary to the detective’s notebook, and introducing new hotkeys and alternative controls.
